title: A New Type of Adversarial Examples
abstract: arXiv:2510.19347v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Most machine learning models are vulnerable to adversarial examples, which poses security concerns on these models. Adversarial examples are crafted by applying subtle but intentionally worst-case modifications to examples from the dataset, leading the model to output a different answer from the original example. In this paper, adversarial examples are formed in an exactly opposite manner, which are significantly different from the original examples but result in the same answer. We propose a novel set of algorithms to produce such adversarial examples, including the negative iterative fast gradient sign method (NI-FGSM) and the negative iterative fast gradient method (NI-FGM), along with their momentum variants: the negative momentum iterative fast gradient sign method (NMI-FGSM) and the negative momentum iterative fast gradient method (NMI-FGM). translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.19347v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：大多数机器学习模型容易受到对抗样本的影响，这给这些模型带来了安全隐患。对抗样本是通过对数据集中的样本进行细微但故意最坏的修改而生成的，导致模型输出与原始样本不同的答案。在本文中，对抗样本以完全相反的方式形成，即它们与原始样本显著不同，但产生相同的答案。我们提出了一组新颖的算法来生成此类对抗样本，包括负迭代快速梯度符号法（NI-FGSM）和负迭代快速梯度法（NI-FGM），以及它们的动量变体：负动量迭代快速梯度符号法（NMI-FGSM）和负动量迭代快速梯度法（NMI-FGM）。通过这些方法构建的对抗样本可用于执行攻击。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新型对抗样本生成方法，通过创建与原始样本显著不同但输出相同结果的样本，并开发了多种负迭代算法及其动量变体来实现这一目标。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new type of adversarial examples that are significantly different from original inputs yet yield the same output, and introduces novel negative iterative algorithms with momentum variants to generate them.
